capabilities.intent: One call registers the use-case services, so the host does not name each by hand.
capabilities.reuse: Call services.AddApplication() from the API composition root.

capabilities.intent: One call wires the database and repositories, so the host does not know EF Core details.
capabilities.reuse: Call services.AddInfrastructure(connectionString) from the API composition root, then InitializeDatabaseAsync on startup.

capabilities.intent: One place maps Result to HTTP, so no endpoint invents its own status handling.
capabilities.reuse: Derive request/response endpoints from ResultEndpoint and call SendResultAsync.

capabilities.intent: Expected failures travel as data, not exceptions.
capabilities.reuse: Return Result<T> from handlers; do not throw for validation or not-found. Endpoints map it to a transport status.

capabilities.intent: The only place that touches EF Core for users; the application never sees a DbContext.
capabilities.reuse: Registered for IUserRepository by AddInfrastructure; do not new it up directly.

capabilities.intent: The use-case layer owns the persistence contract it needs, not the database.
capabilities.reuse: Depend on IUserRepository from application services; implement it in Infrastructure only.

capabilities.intent: One cohesive place for the user use-case logic, independent of transport and database.
capabilities.reuse: Inject UserService into endpoints; it speaks IUserRepository, never EF Core directly.

capabilities.intent: One typed map of operations so HTTP and IPC cannot disagree about a shape.
capabilities.reuse: Add an operation here first; response types must resolve to generated DTOs.

capabilities.intent: Compiler-enforced parity: every operation has both an HTTP route and an IPC command.
capabilities.reuse: Add the operation to Operations, then its ROUTES and COMMANDS entry; omissions fail the build.

capabilities.intent: Every control receives the same two inputs, checked at compile time.
capabilities.reuse: `export class MyControl extends SchemaFormControl {}`, then register it.

capabilities.intent: A control kind is registered data, never a branch inside SchemaForm.
capabilities.reuse: Declare one per control and pass it to provideFormControls() in app config.

capabilities.intent: Option values are owned by z.enum; meta owns only the words.
capabilities.reuse: Call from any option-bearing control with its FieldSpec.

capabilities.intent: Control choice is a lookup over registered data, not a switch in a component.
capabilities.reuse: Inject it; register kinds with provideFormControls(). Order is semantic — first match wins.

capabilities.intent: A repeater is a registered control that recurses through the same outlet.
capabilities.reuse: Inferred from z.array(); .min(n) seeds n rows at build time.

capabilities.intent: z.boolean() infers a checkbox with no meta required.
capabilities.reuse: Registered in controls/index.ts; override with control: 'switch' once one exists.

capabilities.intent: z.date() infers a picker; the control carries its own adapter dependency.
capabilities.reuse: Registered in controls/index.ts. Nothing else needs changing to use it.

capabilities.intent: Nesting is a registered control, not a special case in the renderer.
capabilities.reuse: Inferred from z.object(); nothing to configure.

capabilities.intent: z.array(z.enum()) infers a chip multi-select, not a repeater of selects.
capabilities.reuse: Registered before the generic array repeater — order is semantic.

capabilities.intent: A bound `[type]="'number'"` looks equivalent to a static one but is not.
capabilities.reuse: Registered as the `number` kind in controls/index.ts.

capabilities.intent: Same values as select, different affordance, chosen by meta.control.
capabilities.reuse: Set control: 'radio' on an enum field's meta.

capabilities.intent: z.enum() infers a select with no meta beyond the label.
capabilities.reuse: Override with control: 'radio' for the same values as radio buttons.

capabilities.intent: One component per input shape, not per zod type.
capabilities.reuse: Registered as three definitions in controls/index.ts.

capabilities.intent: Override-only kinds carry no matches() predicate.
capabilities.reuse: Set control: 'textarea' on the field's meta.

capabilities.intent: The default catalog is one ordered list, reviewable in one place.
capabilities.reuse: Call provideDefaultFormControls() in app config. Add a kind with a new file plus one entry.

capabilities.intent: Render any zod schema at runtime; the schema stays the source of truth.
capabilities.reuse: Pass a zod object schema whose fields carry FormFieldMeta; listen to (submitted).

capabilities.intent: The cell, its span and its error slot are stated once, not per container.
capabilities.reuse: Render any FieldSpec with its AbstractControl through this component.

capabilities.intent: Field presentation lives on the schema field, not in a parallel config object.
capabilities.reuse: Attach with `.meta({...} satisfies FormFieldMeta)` on each zod field, AFTER any .optional()/.nullable()/.default() wrapper where practical.

capabilities.intent: The render tree is data derived from the schema, never hand-authored.
capabilities.reuse: Produced by SchemaFormBuilder.fieldsFromSchema; consumed by SchemaForm and every control.

capabilities.intent: One walk of the schema produces both the render tree and the control tree.
capabilities.reuse: Inject it; call fieldsFromSchema(node) then buildControl(spec). Both work on any node.

capabilities.intent: Field presentation stays on the zod schema; components read it, never duplicate it.
capabilities.reuse: Call resolveMeta(node, path) for one node, or formMeta(objectSchema) for a whole shape.

capabilities.intent: Domain-facing user data access that is oblivious to HTTP vs IPC.
capabilities.reuse: Inject UserRepository from ViewModels; copy this shape for new feature repositories.

capabilities.intent: The thick client's user use-cases, mirroring the API so both wires agree.
capabilities.reuse: Manage one UserStore in the Tauri app state; commands delegate to it.

capabilities.intent: Replace a fixed-duration sleep in a spec with a predicate poll that fails loudly, by name, on a genuine timeout instead of racing a guess.
capabilities.reuse: Any spec waiting out an async CDK overlay: pass a predicate for the DOM state you want and a tick, e.g. `() => fixture.detectChanges()`.

capabilities.intent: One error type above the seam, so no ViewModel grows two error branches.
capabilities.reuse: Called only by NormalizingTransport. Do not catch raw wire errors elsewhere.

capabilities.intent: The thin-client wire; route knowledge lives in the registry, not in callers.
capabilities.reuse: Selected by provideTransport when not under Tauri. Do not call directly.

capabilities.intent: The thick-client wire; command knowledge lives in the registry, not in callers.
capabilities.reuse: Selected by provideTransport under Tauri. Do not call directly.

capabilities.intent: One error seam; every failure above it is already an AppError.
capabilities.reuse: Wrap the selected Transport at bootstrap. Never add error branching above this.

capabilities.intent: One abstract seam; View, ViewModel, and repositories never learn which wire is live.
capabilities.reuse: Inject Transport (the DI token) and call request(op, payload). Never branch on wire above this.

capabilities.intent: Collapse the whole "which world" decision to one factory at startup.
capabilities.reuse: Call provideTransport(apiBaseUrl) in the app config. Nothing else selects a wire.

capabilities.intent: Browse every vendored spartan component, one page each, with verified usages.
capabilities.reuse: Route to /showcase. Add a component page under showcase/pages and register it in component-registry.ts.

capabilities.intent: Switch the app between light and dark, remembering the choice.
capabilities.reuse: Inject it and call toggle(), or bind to mode(). Applied globally from the shell header.
